Card Q&A.q: How many [Machinedramon] cards can I place under this card when I DigiXros it?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, that's correct. In addition to Digimon from the hand or battle area, you may also place cards from the trash for the DigiXros.
Card Q&A.q: Does "cards from your trash may also be placed for this card's DigiXros" mean that I can place cards from my hand, battle area, and/or trash for the DigiXros?

Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a black Tamer, cards from your trash may also be placed for this card's DigiXros.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Cyborg] or [SoC] trait card from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, delete up to 7 play cost's total worth of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by trashing 2 [Cyborg], [Machine] or [SoC] trait cards in its digivolution cards, prevent it from leaving.
